other_observations: Took 30 min against a 20 min budget.
Balanced class weights left probabilities uncalibrated (Brier 0.225); noted as a caveat, not fixed.
No noise floor: 'LR beat trees 0.208 vs 0.183-0.190' is stated without judging it against fold spread.
No locked holdout between tuning and the test set.
Dropped last_invoice_amount entirely, losing a legitimate informative-missingness signal (answer key).
